group.wordStacks: word from “Rules” — counted as set there

word.unknown: How the word is counted and what cancels it is set in “Rules → Roll edits”.
word.stacks: “{{name}}” is counted once per different effect; copies of one effect count once.
word.once: “{{name}}” applies to a roll once, however many effects grant it.
word.rivalsOne: {{lead}} Meets {{list}} — they cancel each other one for one.

hint.sum: Stacks: each hanging effect and each of its copies adds its own number.
hint.tag: The roll gets the tag once, however many effects grant it.

mod.whenRule: On the holder’s sheet. If it does not match, the edit does not apply.
mod.addCallTip: Edits a call: a roll (advantage, addend) or an effect input (double damage from fire)

empty.hint: A passive effect edits numbers: gives a bonus to a field or hangs advantage on a roll.
empty.title: The effect does nothing yet

mod.tagHint: A formula that gives the tag text, for example “no Advantage”.
mod.wordHint: Ready-made mechanisms will arrive in the “Roll edits” dictionary with all the words.
mod.tagWhereHint: Looks at the tag’s row in a table: one fact instead of a list of tags.
mod.ifHolder: The holder is the sheet this edit hangs on.

cond.title: Only if
cond.holderHint: The holder is the sheet this hangs on.

degree.first: The first one that fits from the top is taken.
degree.elseTip: all outcomes that did not fit the degrees above

target.noSheets: — the effect has no sheet inputs —

rolls.hintRule: “{{name}}” — rolls by the fields of this rule and step rolls with the tag “{{tag}}”.
rolls.hintTwo: One roll cannot have two rules at once — take “Or at least one of”.
rolls.hintAll: The roll must match everything chosen.
rolls.anyHint: One of these tags is enough. Empty — not checked.
rolls.notHint: A roll with any of these tags does not fit. Empty — not checked.

problems.head: Problems: {{list}}
problems.errorsTip: a system with errors is not published
problems.noneHint: All references are in place, names are filled in, effects are connected.

value.placeholder: number or formula — start typing a name

rollExpr.start: a roll starts with a die: “1d20” or “1d20 + bonus”
rollExpr.pickName: {{name}} — pick a name from the list

shape.wordMath: a word cannot be added to or multiplied with a number
shape.wantNumber: a number is needed, but this is a word
shape.wantWord: a word is needed, but this is a number

slots.eventTags: call tags: values of the choices
